documents: Visa or proof of immigration status (non-UK citizens)
HMRC Transfer of Residence (ToR1) approval letter with its URN
Signed, complete inventory in English, with no vague entries
Proof you lived abroad for the past 12 months (bill, bank statement, lease)
Proof of why you're moving, e.g. job offer or UK rental contract
Your UK address (a temporary one is fine)
Copy of the bill of lading or air waybill
dutyFree: Used belongings you owned and used abroad for at least 6 months
You must have lived outside the UK for at least 12 months
Goods must arrive within 12 months of your move and not be sold for 12 months
Cars and motorbikes qualify on the same terms under the same application
restricted: Alcohol and tobacco always pay duty and VAT; list them on the ToR1
Banned: meat, fish and dairy foods, unlicensed drugs, offensive weapons, fake goods
Firearms, ammunition, explosives and radio transmitters usually need a licence
Ivory, furs, reptile skin and other endangered-species items need a CITES permit
Pets need a microchip and rabies vaccine; unapproved countries mean 6-month quarantine
notes: Apply online to HMRC for Transfer of Residence relief as early as possible
Don't ship until HMRC approves; give the URN to your mover before arrival
Approval can take from one day to several weeks
Alcohol, tobacco and items owned under 6 months are cleared separately
